content: Service Name Ifl_IpoCur_<InTypeMn>_f32 Syntax float32 Ifl_IpoCur_<InTypeMn>_f32 ( const Ifl_DPResultF32_Type * dpResult, const <InType> * Val_array ) Service ID [hex] 0x13 to 0x16 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant dpResult Data point search result Parameters (in) Val_array Pointer to the result axis distribution array Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value float32 Result of the interpolation Description Based on searched indices and ratios information using the relevant Ifl_DPSearch_f32 routine, this routine calculates and returns the interpolation result for a curve.
